mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: the skies are clear at Verona City Hall under a new moon. The overnight low will drop to 52 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast.

City residents should be aware that police responded to a burglary in progress on Hunter's Cove Way on September 10, resulting in one arrest and the recovery of a handgun. Additionally, election notices for the November general election are now available on the city website.

There is plenty to do around town. The Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival is tomorrow, and you can also catch live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking further ahead, yoga is scheduled for September 14, and trivia nights are set for September 15 and 16 at various local spots.
On September 10, Verona officers responded to a burglary on Hunter's Cove Way. A 19-year-old suspect was taken into custody after a handgun and shell casing were recovered from the scene.
Today's flavor was Caramel Cashew. The store is now closed for the evening, but you can head over when doors open tomorrow at 10:00 AM to try tomorrow's flavor, Really Reese's.
